title: Rave Master - Special Attack Force!
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health, special meter
2D fighter based on the Rave Master manga and anime
Each fighter has a health bar and a special gauge that fills while you fight

Haru, Elie, Musica and others from Rave Master
Characters include Haru Glory and his friends and rivals from the series
Each character has normal attacks, special moves and a gauge-powered super
Learn one character's specials first: they share simple command inputs

Specials use the meter; block and counter
Block high and low; counter after the opponent's whiffed special
Keep the gauge for a super that finishes the round
Air attacks beat slow ground specials

Story, VS
Story mode follows the cast through a series of fights with scenes between them

rows: pick any unlocked fighter and stage

widgets.text:
Special moves per fighter
Supers cost gauge; the gauge carries between rounds in many fighters, so plan ahead
Each fighter's command list is in the pause menu

Fighters unlocked
Clearing story mode with characters unlocks more fighters
Try every character in story mode to see all endings

Story wins
Story mode progress is per character
Unlock the full roster by clearing story routes
